notes:
- New bookkeeping layer: everything you record is posted to a chart of accounts automatically in the background — entry screens stay the same, with no account codes to choose
- Your country's chart of accounts is set up at first setup (local charts for Turkey and 21 European countries; other countries get a standard chart in their own currency)
- New Financial reports screen: balance sheet, income statement, trial balance with opening balances, ledgers, cash flow and changes in equity, plus financial analysis ratios
- Reports by period (all, this month, this year, last year) with an optional comparison to the same period a year earlier, including the change in %
- Fixed assets: vehicles, buildings, land and equipment with detailed fields; buy, sell or scrap them, record assets you already owned, or record a purchase directly from the expense and payable screens
- New transaction types: owner contribution, owner draw, loan given, bank loan, interest paid and received, and buying an asset on credit
- The chart of accounts shows each account's balance and its currency amounts
- A corrected record now appears as a single row marked "Corrected"
- Payment types are defined in one place (Definitions > Payment types); new sub-types get their own account automatically
- Tables widen columns to fit names, and your column choices are saved per user inside your encrypted data
- Bookkeeping mode in Settings > Company: Simple (the default, everything automatic) or Advanced, which shows the chart of accounts and lets you choose the ledger account of each payment type
- Ledgers show a description for every entry; currency columns start hidden, and financial statements open on this year with the comparison turned on
- About is now its own page in the System menu
- Sample data now shows every kind of record
- Stronger protection of the program's stored check results
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
